thisGoalTurnClassification: progress: uncommitted native protocol, strict parser and journal primitive implemented, tested, independently reviewed, protocol independently qualified; full feature remains WIP.

designDecisions.native: Explicit input-session features + per-worker incarnation. Actual InputRequest body hook emits challenge/nonce/op/raw-frame SHA256 entry, then waits at most2s for matching continue before any business cleanup/recording/action. Unique reader owns request+continue bytes, including prefetched tails. Control is stripped before business payload. Legacy single-terminal requests unchanged.
designDecisions.journal: Strict exclusive invocation directory, private actual argument blobs, serialized fsync append with atomic committed watermark. pending.json preserves previous watermark across post-rename directory-fsync failures; successful final guard unlink is process-crash publication point. Cross-process EX/SH file locks serialize writer/reader snapshots; NONBLOCK then owned-regular validation prevents FIFO hangs. No power-loss claim.
designDecisions.node_and_ACC: Still pending: immutable execution args after approval/privacy repair, strict Node persisted preparation, reserved tools/call _meta host-generated correlation, accepted vs actual wrapper/defaults/native frame stages, batch parent/step IDs, all context cleanup, unknown/replay guard and reconciliation. Metadata is not authorization and supplies no file paths.
